title: Energy metabolism design of the striated muscle cell

result: Narrative review. Creatine kinase catalyses MgADP + PCr + H+ = MgATP + Cr (Keq 100 at 1 mM Mg2+, pH 7.0) and is believed to operate near equilibrium in heart and skeletal muscle. The PCr pool serves as a short-term buffer for ATP, of small capacity because PCr exceeds ATP only twofold in heart and fourfold in muscle; creatine kinase can transiently maintain ATP using PCr for a few seconds. Bessman and co-workers proposed a creatine kinase shuttle carrying high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to myofibrils; many have questioned it, creatine kinase knockout mice show very modest changes, and the authors conclude the shuttle has a potentially secondary role.
